audit_method: Same-agent comparison against the frozen source and the cited controlling definitions and rule table within that same frozen revision. No claim about current upstream master is made.

corrections.finding: The generic sequent uses independently sized left and right sequences but ends both at index m, contradicting the controlling sequent definition's A_1,...,A_m and B_1,...,B_n notation.
corrections.handling: Ended the right sequence at B_n and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: upstream/content/first-order-logic/sequent-calculus/rules-and-proofs.tex defines Gamma as A_1,...,A_m and Delta as B_1,...,B_n.

corrections.finding: The false-conjunction tableau rule is named with the entire operand formula A∧B in the rule-name slot, whereas the controlling rule table and every ordinary use name the connective ∧ only.
corrections.handling: Restored the false-conjunction rule name F∧ and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: upstream/content/first-order-logic/tableaux/propositional-rules.tex defines the false-conjunction rule as \TRule{\False}{\land} and the frozen tree examples use that name.

corrections.finding: The consistency paragraph requires only some B_i to belong to Gamma although the displayed tableau contains all B_1,...,B_n; that condition would not make the tableau an inconsistency witness for Gamma.
corrections.handling: Required B_i to belong to Gamma for every i=1,...,n and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: upstream/content/first-order-logic/tableaux/proof-theoretic-notions.tex defines tableau consistency with a finite set {B_1,...,B_n} contained in Gamma.

corrections.finding: Both formulas obtained by decomposing the true conjunction on tableau line 2 are labelled with the true-conditional rule, although they are applications of the true-conjunction rule.
corrections.handling: Changed both line-2 justification labels from T→ to T∧ and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The immediately preceding tableau line is T(A∧B), and upstream/content/first-order-logic/tableaux/propositional-rules.tex assigns its linear decomposition to \TRule{\True}{\land}.
